segments.body: Manage service entries and switch states in one governed control surface.

segments.title: Interoperability APIs
segments.body: Expose standards-aware endpoints for identity, academic workflows, and data exchange.

segments.title: Operational safeguards

faqs.question: Which standards do you support?
faqs.answer: The platform supports patterns such as LTI, OneRoster, SCIM, and versioned REST APIs—see developer docs for the current matrix.

faqs.question: Who can turn integrations on?
faqs.answer: Tenant and platform governance rules control activation; changes are auditable.
